in_marathi.name: Chinraaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। God of the moon and night, Chinraaj is a name deeply rooted in Hindu mythology. Chin (moon) and Raaj (king) combine to mean 'King of the Moon'.
